component.name: Tutankhamun
component.summary: Pharaoh + Cleopatra on the files of your own copy of the game

description.p: Tutankhamun is an open-source re-implementation of Pharaoh + Cleopatra 2.1 (Impressions Games, 2000) with the original's game logic, look and saved games. It needs the data files of an installed Pharaoh + Cleopatra (GOG, Steam or an original CD-ROM version updated to 2.1); no game assets are included.
